name: Joint planning of economy and reliability for integrated community energy systems: A similarity-based massive scenario optimization approach
headline: Joint planning of economy and reliability for integrated community energy systems
keywords: joint planning of economy and reliability
description: This paper proposes a joint economy and reliability planning model for integrated community energy systems and accelerates massive scenario optimization with a state similarity method.
citation: Qu, Jiawei, Zeyu Liu, Kai Hou, Yue Zhou, Lewei Zhu, Xiaohong Dong, Yunfei Mu, and Hongjie Jia. "Joint planning of economy and reliability for integrated community energy systems: A similarity-based massive scenario optimization approach." Applied Energy 381 (2025): 125054. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.apenergy.2024.125054
